verdict.rationale: Google publishes a public pricing page (gemini-docs-14/18/31) with pay-as-you-go pricing for production apps, and community evidence confirms actual per-token figures are known/discussed publicly (gemini-comm-9 cites specific $/M input-output rates), showing prices are accessible without sales contact. However, the evidence pack doesn't show the actual per-token price table itself, only references to the pricing page and tier-gated rate limits requiring cloud spend history to unlock higher tiers (gemini-comm-1), which adds friction beyond simple public price lookup. missing for 10: direct evidence of a complete per-model price table in the docs, confirmation that ALL current models (not just examples) have listed public prices, and resolution of the tier-gating friction reported by users.
